name: Wurmple
notes: Painted design: red back (18) and head parts (8, 9, 10, 16) with a fine light crackle of wrinkle lines and soft darker blotches over each body segment; cream belly (2) split into segments by dark olive fold lines plus a short centre line at the head end, with soft shading inside each segment; yellow spikes (11, 12 tail, 15 head) with a painted brown base; white claw-like prolegs (1, 3-7, 13, 14, 17, 19).

So: caterpillar skin = soft, slightly waxy cuticle. Red skin keeps only its painted wrinkle crackle as micro relief (no bumps added); the belly folds become soft grooves exactly on the painted fold lines; spikes are smooth keratin with a little more gloss; prolegs untouched. Skin roughness stays the artist's (_par carries a painted sparkle pattern; making the skin rougher spread the highlight over it and it read as speckles).
Body shader 1731682751 has no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load; Body_nor is cache-only.
